items.name: Marginal stability
items.definition: Marginal stability：If the jω-axis roots of the characteristic equation are simple, the system is neither stable nor unstable

items.name: Open-loop system poles location
items.definition: Open-loop system poles location：Open-loop system poles are located at approximately (10, 0), (-1, 0), and (-10, 0).

items.name: relay with dead zone
items.definition: relay with dead zone：relay with dead zone

items.name: 周期采样
items.definition: 如果在有规律的间隔上，系统取到了离散信息，则这种采样称为周期采样。

items.name: 幂级数法
items.definition: 通过对z变换函数E(z)直接作综合除法，得到按z^{-1}升幂排列的幂级数展开式，从而得到采样脉冲序列的脉冲强度。
